features.name: Patient Registration and Authentication
features.description: Patients create accounts and securely log in to manage their profile and appointments.
user_stories: As a patient, I can register with my email and personal details so that I can book appointments online.
As a patient, I can reset my password so that I can regain access to my account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new visitor, When they submit valid registration details, Then an account is created and a verification email is sent.
Given a registered patient, When they enter valid credentials, Then they are logged in and see their dashboard.

features.name: Doctor Search and Availability
features.description: Patients search doctors by name, specialty, or department and view available time slots.
user_stories: As a patient, I can search doctors by specialty so that I can find the right care provider.
As a doctor, I can set my weekly availability so that patients only book slots when I am working.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specialty filter, When a patient searches, Then only matching doctors with open slots are listed.
Given a doctor updates availability, When a patient views the schedule, Then the new slots are shown within 1 minute.

features.name: Appointment Scheduling and Management
features.description: Patients book, reschedule, and cancel appointments with doctors without double-booking.
user_stories: As a patient, I can book an available slot with a doctor so that I secure a visit time.
As a patient, I can reschedule or cancel an appointment so that I can adapt to changes in my schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Given an open slot, When a patient confirms a booking, Then the slot is reserved and no other patient can book it.
Given an existing appointment, When the patient cancels at least 24 hours before, Then the slot is released and a confirmation is sent.

features.name: Notifications and Reminders
features.description: The system sends email and SMS confirmations and reminders for upcoming appointments.
user_stories: As a patient, I can receive a reminder before my appointment so that I do not miss my visit.
As a doctor, I can be notified of new or cancelled bookings so that I can plan my day.
acceptance_criteria: Given a confirmed appointment, When it is 24 hours away, Then the patient receives an email or SMS reminder.
Given a patient cancels, When the cancellation is saved, Then the doctor is notified within 5 minutes.

features.name: Admin Management Dashboard
features.description: Hospital administrators manage doctors, departments, schedules, and view appointment reports.
user_stories: As an admin, I can add and manage doctor profiles and departments so that listings stay accurate.
As an admin, I can view appointment reports so that I can monitor utilization and no-show rates.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin is logged in, When they add a doctor profile, Then the doctor appears in patient search results.
Given a date range, When an admin runs a report, Then total, completed, and cancelled appointments are displayed.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Pages load in under 2 seconds and booking requests complete in under 3 seconds at 500 concurrent users.
All traffic uses TLS 1.2+, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and role-based access control is enforced on every endpoint.
The system maintains 99.9% monthly uptime, excluding scheduled maintenance windows announced 48 hours ahead.
Patient data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and access to patient records is logged in an audit trail.
A patient can complete an appointment booking in no more than 5 steps on desktop or mobile browsers.
